dialogues.jp:
猫でも音夢でも、一声鳴いてくれればいいもの
を。
dialogues.en: A cat or Nemu, whichever it is, once is enough.
dialogues.text: A cat or Nemu, whichever it is, once is enough.

dialogues.jp: 「ちくしょう、安眠妨害もいいところだ」
dialogues.en: "God damn it! You're stopping me sleep."
dialogues.text: "God damn it! You're stopping me sleep."

dialogues.jp:
日曜の午後に、なにが悲しくて茂みをかきわけ
なくてはならないのか……。
dialogues.en:
On a Sunday afternoon, who the heck will be rummaging
through a bush?
dialogues.text:
On a Sunday afternoon, who the heck will be rummaging
through a bush?

dialogues.jp: 足元のちっこい猫を抱きあげてため息をつく。
dialogues.en: I sigh as I hold up a little cat.
dialogues.text: I sigh as I hold up a little cat.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en:
I guess it was my wild imagination to think of Nemu doing
this in the bush.
dialogues.text:
I guess it was my wild imagination to think of Nemu doing
this in the bush.

dialogues.jp:
首――首が本当にあるのか知らないが――を曲
げて、猫が林の奥を示す。
「もしかしてご主人様とはぐれたのか？」
dialogues.en:
The cat looks at the trees, bending her neck, which is hard
to see.
dialogues.text:
The cat looks at the trees, bending her neck, which is hard
to see.

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en: "You must've got separated from your owner."
dialogues.text: "You must've got separated from your owner."

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.jp:
「そっか……面倒だな……見つかるように祈っ
　ていてやろう」

dialogues.speaker: Utamaru
dialogues.en:
"Well, that's a bummer, but I hope your owner will find you
soon."
dialogues.text:
"Well, that's a bummer, but I hope your owner will find you
soon."

dialogues.jp:
すりすり、と目をうるませながら猫が胸に顔を
すりよせ、しっぽを手に巻いてくる。
dialogues.en:
The cat snuggles up to my chest through a mist of tears,
twining her tail around my hand.
dialogues.text:
The cat snuggles up to my chest through a mist of tears,
twining her tail around my hand.

dialogues.en: "Okay... I'll help you find your owner."
dialogues.text: "Okay... I'll help you find your owner."

dialogues.jp: 頭をかきながらとぼとぼ、と歩き出す。
dialogues.en: I start strolling along, scratching my head.
dialogues.text: I start strolling along, scratching my head.

dialogues.jp: がさがさ、と林を抜けてしまう。
ぺしぺし、としっぽで叩かれる。
dialogues.en: She slaps me with her tail.
dialogues.text: She slaps me with her tail.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "Well, what about the other eighty percent?"
dialogues.text: "Well, what about the other eighty percent?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.en: "That was the part about finding your owner."
dialogues.text: "That was the part about finding your owner."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もし、愛しのさくらが茂みの中で野盗にでも
　襲われてたらどうする？」
dialogues.en: "What if your darling Sakura has been attacked by a robber?"
dialogues.text: "What if your darling Sakura has been attacked by a robber?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そんな物好きはいないだろう」
dialogues.en: "Who would bother doing that to her?"
dialogues.text: "Who would bother doing that to her?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「そうかなぁ……世の中にはそういう人もいる
　と思うけど？」
dialogues.en:
"Well, you never know, there are some guys who like to do
that."
dialogues.text:
"Well, you never know, there are some guys who like to do
that."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「見た目は子供で中身が大人？」
dialogues.en:
"Even though she looks like a child, she's mature enough
inside."
dialogues.text:
"Even though she looks like a child, she's mature enough
inside."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ははは、猫のくせによく喋るなぁ」
dialogues.en: "Haha, you talk a lot even you're only a cat."
dialogues.text: "Haha, you talk a lot even you're only a cat."

dialogues.jp: と笑いながら隣を見る。
dialogues.en: I look beside me with a smile.
dialogues.text: I look beside me with a smile.

dialogues.jp: ぴょん、と猫がさくらの胸に飛び込む。
dialogues.en: The cat suddenly jumps onto Sakura's bosom.
dialogues.text: The cat suddenly jumps onto Sakura's bosom.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うたまる〜！　ごめんよ〜！　ボク鳩を追い
　まわすのに夢中で！」
dialogues.en:
"Sorry, Utamaru! I got completely distracted chasing a
pigeon."
dialogues.text:
"Sorry, Utamaru! I got completely distracted chasing a
pigeon."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「もぅ離さないからなぁ！　今生の約束だ〜！
　生きるも一緒、死ぬも一緒、餌は半分こ！」
dialogues.en:
"I will never let you go! I swear it on my life! We live
together, die together, and share our meals!"
dialogues.text:
"I will never let you go! I swear it on my life! We live
together, die together, and share our meals!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「餌は一人前？　でも、キャットフードは美味
　しいから一口だけいいでしょ？」
dialogues.en:
"One meal for one person, but the cat food is delicious, so
I can have one bite of yours, right?"
dialogues.text:
"One meal for one person, but the cat food is delicious, so
I can have one bite of yours, right?"

dialogues.jp: ぎゅ〜っ、と猫を抱きしめて微笑む。
dialogues.en: She smiles, hugging the cat close against herself.
dialogues.text: She smiles, hugging the cat close against herself.

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……と言うわけでボクはこれで失礼をば」
dialogues.en: "Well, that's how it is, and I've gotta go."
dialogues.text: "Well, that's how it is, and I've gotta go."

dialogues.jp:
猫を頭にのせて、さくらがこそこそ、と歩き出
す。
dialogues.en: Sakura starts to walk off, with the cat on her head.
dialogues.text: Sakura starts to walk off, with the cat on her head.

dialogues.en: "Is that all? After you made me wait this long?"
dialogues.text: "Is that all? After you made me wait this long?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「だってだって、鳩さんが可愛かったんだよぉ。
　ポッポー、ポッポーって」
dialogues.en: "Because the pigeon was so cute, cooing all over."
dialogues.text: "Because the pigeon was so cute, cooing all over."

dialogues.jp: ため息をついて、ねこの頭をなでる。
dialogues.en: I sigh, then pet the cat.
dialogues.text: I sigh, then pet the cat.

dialogues.jp: ぼそぼそ、と小さな呟き。

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「あにゅ……お兄ちゃん、お礼してもいい？」
dialogues.en: "Umm... oniichan, I want to make it up to you."
dialogues.text: "Umm... oniichan, I want to make it up to you."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「どこかでお茶でも｛おご／奢｝るよ♪」
dialogues.en: "Let's go for some tea as my treat!"
dialogues.text: "Let's go for some tea as my treat!"

dialogues.jp: それはお礼というか、なんというか……。
dialogues.en:
I think I should call it something else rather than a token
of her appreciation.
dialogues.text:
I think I should call it something else rather than a token
of her appreciation.

dialogues.jp: 「分かったよ。まぁ、奢られよう。暇だしな」
dialogues.en:
"Okay. I'll be your guest, and I don't have anything else to
do."
dialogues.text:
"Okay. I'll be your guest, and I don't have anything else to
do."

dialogues.jp:
腰に抱きついてくるさくらをつれて、どこか高
いお茶はないかと考える俺だった。
dialogues.en:
Leading Sakura as she clings around my waist, I try to think
of a place where the tea is expensive.
dialogues.text:
Leading Sakura as she clings around my waist, I try to think
of a place where the tea is expensive.

dialogues.jp:
気になって草むらを漁ると、それは音夢ではな
くさくらの飼い猫の鈴の音だった。
dialogues.en:
I went inside the bush to find out what it was. What I found
wasn't Nemu, but the sound of a bell hanging on Sakura's
cat.
dialogues.text:
I went inside the bush to find out what it was. What I found
wasn't Nemu, but the sound of a bell hanging on Sakura's
cat.

dialogues.jp:
迷子だったそいつをさくらに届けると、お礼と
いうことで茶屋で｛おご／奢｝るということになった。
うん。いいことはするべきだな。
dialogues.en:
I handed the lost cat to Sakura, then Sakura decided to
treat me at a cafe in return. Yes, every good deed has
rewards.
dialogues.text:
I handed the lost cat to Sakura, then Sakura decided to
treat me at a cafe in return. Yes, every good deed has
rewards.
